verdict.rationale: Galileo's MCP server lets AI-powered IDEs (Cursor, VS Code+Copilot) create datasets, run experiments, and manage prompts via natural-language driven agent tooling, and release notes mention an 'AI Assistant' for troubleshooting agentic systems—both suggesting NL-command operation. However, there's no detailed documentation of a dedicated in-product chat/NL interface for the Galileo console itself beyond the MCP bridge and a brief AI Assistant mention. Missing for 10: first-party docs detailing a native NL command interface within the Galileo UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the AI Assistant's NL capabilities.
